name: type:bug
description: Something shipped does not work as documented

name: type:enhancement
description: New skill, capability or convention, or a change to how one works

name: type:docs
description: README, AGENTS.md, RELEASING.md, examples/ or docs/ only

name: breaking
description: Breaks consumers without a migration; ships only in a major

name: area:skills
description: skills/ (a shipped skill body, trigger or reference)

name: area:lib
description: lib/ helpers called by skills and hooks

name: area:framework-files
description: framework-files/, blueprints/, templates/ and the manifest; init and update

name: P1
description: Wrong result, data loss, security, or blocks consumers; fix before the next release

name: P2
description: Real defect or friction with a workaround; next few PRs

name: status:needs-triage
description: Not yet triaged; the issue-triage workflow adds it on open

name: status:needs-repro
description: Did not reproduce on current main; waiting for a repro

name: status:needs-split
description: Bundles several problems; split into sub-issues before work starts

name: status:ready
description: Triaged and reproduced; can be picked up

name: status:blocked
description: Waiting on another issue, PR or decision (named in a comment)
